Class LogTableUtil

java.lang.Object
com.stuypulse.robot.util.talonfx.logged.LogTableUtil
public final class LogTableUtil extends Object

Log Table Utility

Utility methods for reading and writing dynamically typed values to and from a LogTable.

This centralizes type handling without having to duplicate the same if else logic in multiple places.

  • Method Details

    • put

      public static void put(org.littletonrobotics.junction.LogTable table, String key, Object value)
      Puts a value into a LogTable with the given key, automatically handling the type of the value.
      Parameters:
      table - the LogTable to put the value into
      key - The key where the value will be stored.
      value - The value to store in the LogTable. If it's not a supported type, it will be converted to a string.

    • putArray

      private static void putArray(org.littletonrobotics.junction.LogTable table, String key, Object array)
      Puts an array value into a LogTable, dispatching to the corresponding array overload. Falls back to a String[] for element types with no array overload such as a Measure or boxed wrapper types.

    • get

      public static <T> T get(org.littletonrobotics.junction.LogTable table, String key, T defaultValue)
      Gets a value from a LogTable with the given key, automatically handling the type of the value based on the provided default value.
      Type Parameters:
      T - The type of the value.
      Parameters:
      table - The LogTable to get the value from.
      key - The key where the valid is stored.
      defaultValue - The default value to return if the key does not exist in the LogTable .
      Returns:
      The value from the LogTable if it exists, otherwise the default value.

    • getArray

      private static Object getArray(org.littletonrobotics.junction.LogTable table, String key, Object defaultArray)
      Gets an array value from a LogTable, dispatching to the corresponding array overload. Types with no array overload such as Measure or boxed wrapper types aren't replayable, so the default array is returned back.
